title: SailPoint Unveils 2027 Identity Security Predictions: The Era of "Ungoverned Agentic AI" Ends as Legal Baselines, Executive Accountability, and Intent Redefine the Enterprise
headline: SailPoint 2027 Identity Security Predictions for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: SailPoint has released identity security predictions for 2027, warning that enterprises face a 40:1 agent security gap where autonomous agents operate in production without adequate governance. The research highlights risks from unmanaged machine secrets, agentic supply-chain vulnerabilities, and regulatory pressures. It predicts a shift toward continuous intent assurance, out-of-band identity control planes, and strict accountability for AI deployments.
why_it_matters: Organisations deploying autonomous AI agents must establish rigorous identity governance and zero standing privilege controls to meet upcoming regulatory, board, and insurer expectations.

quotes.text: 79% of enterprises are already running AI agents in production, yet only 2% have deployed identity security purpose-built to secure them.

In 2027, while it will be possible to delegate a complex workflow to an autonomous agent, it will never be acceptable to delegate accountability, because agent accountability is enterprise responsibility.

classification.significance_reason: Vendor predictions highlighting future identity governance trends for AI agents, without concrete new regulatory mandates.
